nodes.detail: 1.50 kg wet, 1.10 kg dry, 0.40 kg propellant, 70 mm diameter, Cd 0.50, Isp 205 s.

Reference from the 11200-case map: 8° breech, 1.5 m radius clothoid-arc turn at 3 g, then a 65° straight barrel at 14 g. Length 47.3 m. Exit 110 m/s at 42.3 m altitude. Verified by tests/test_path.py, tests/test_tube.py, and data/geometry_map.csv.

Required axial force peaks at 220 N. Electrical size at 20% coil efficiency is 119 kW peak and 48.7 kJ. Coil geometry, timing, and suck-back are not solved. The force profile is data/reference_tube_profile.csv.
Tube-side Si3N4 ball transfers. Peak ball load 16.9 N on the breech turn, spring rate 21.1 kN/m. The straight barrel unloads the balls. Verified by tests/test_bearings.py.
25 mm pads. Chordal rise in the 1.5 m turn is 0.052 mm. Hertz peak is 1.53 GPa on a hard nonmagnetic race, 0.93 GPa on aluminum, 0.15 GPa on PEEK.

Proof burn at the breech is the abort. Position interlock lights the motor on the open rail, nominally 5.8 m past the closed bore. Engine-out landing is a 0.9 m chute at 5.1 m/s. A fully magnetic 1 km apogee at 14 g needs 215 m/s and a 169 m bore.

open_issues: Coil cross-section, trigger timing, and suck-back are not modeled. The force profile is the requirement.
Pulsed-power bus and capacitor mass are not modeled.
Ignition delay is an assumed 20/50/100 ms family, not a measured valve. The position interlock is the protection if the fast tail is quicker than 20 ms.
The muzzle deflector is sized from a 20 degree plume cone. It is not a heat-transfer design.
A hard nonmagnetic rub-strip alloy is not chosen. Aluminum at 0.93 GPa is at the edge of brinelling.
